services.name: Tornado Merchandise
services.desc: On January 9, 2024 our town was woken up to the sound of a tornado warning. We sat in the bathroom switching from the webcam on the booth to watching the weather channel and seeing that it was in the direct path of the Sea Screamer. Just as Cody switched back to check the Webcam again everything went off line. It was that moment that we realized what had happened. As we were coming over the bridge we could clearly see the Sea Screamer was gone! We were met at the base of the bridge with an officer already on the scene minutes after the EF-3 Tornado had passed through our town.
